description: Press the Stop buttons of the user's open R3 editor: stop physics, code, audio and music (all of them, or the ones named in `systems`), exactly as the user's own click does. Stopping physics puts every body back where it was placed. Changes nothing saved. Needs the editor:run right.

projectId.description: A project open in the user's editor (r3_whoami lists them).

systems.description: Which of the editor's Run / Stop buttons: physics, code, audio, music. Leave out for all of them.

name: r3_editor_stop

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Stop the project in the user's open R3 editor
